issues.display_title: Issue #213: API Get Exhibitions (Published / Draft) with Restricted Access, Search, Filtering, and Sorting
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: API Get Exhibitions (Published / Draft) with Restricted Access, Search, Filtering, and Sorting

Files Changed / Added

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions.go (handler with search, status filtering, 6 sorting modes, and key gallery fields)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions_test.go (unit tests covering sort orders, whitelist, and pagination)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes.go (registered GET /published before /:sid)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes_test.go (route integration tests)
  • api-collection/Villume GO/Exhibitions/Get Published Exhibitions.yml (API collection request)

Summary of Implementation

Updated the single endpoint GET /v1/exhibitions/published to support all requirements for the Virtual Galleries management area in the Support dropdown of the Villume Dashboard/Admin:

  • Gallery list with key information: thumbnail, name, user.email (owner email), created_at, published_date, status (published/draft), and user.username (used by Support for account impersonation via POST /v1/auth/impersonate).
  • Search by gallery name or owner email: Case-insensitive search across exhibitions.name, users.email, and users.username.
  • Filtering by Published or Draft status: ?status=published (default), ?status=draft, or ?status=all.
  • Sorting: Multi-column sorting covering all 6 requested modes: recently published, oldest published, recently created, oldest created, name A-Z, and name Z-A.
  • Access Control: Enforces email whitelist restriction to albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com.

Detailed Changes

1. Action Handler (src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions.go)

  • Role & Email Verification:
    • IsAllowedPublishedExhibitionsEmail(email) verifies if the user is albugsp@gmail.com or villumesupport@gmail.com.
    • Non-whitelisted users receive 403 Forbidden.
  • Status Filter: 
    statusFilter := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(c.Query("status")))
switch statusFilter {
case "draft":
    query = query.Where("exhibitions.published = ?", false)
case "all":
    // both published and draft
case "published":
    query = query.Where("exhibitions.published = ?", true)
default:
    query = query.Where("exhibitions.published = ?", true)
}
  • Search Filter: 
    if search != "" {
    searchLike := "%" + search + "%"
    query = query.
        Joins("LEFT JOIN users ON users.id = exhibitions.user_id").
        Where("(exhibitions.name ILIKE ? OR users.email ILIKE ? OR users.username ILIKE ?)", searchLike, searchLike, searchLike)
}
  • Sorting (ResolveExhibitionOrder):
    Maps user parameter sort to SQL clauses:
    • recent_published: exhibitions.published_date DESC NULLS LAST, exhibitions.created_at DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
    • oldest_published: exhibitions.published_date ASC NULLS LAST, exhibitions.created_at ASC, exhibitions.id ASC
    • recent_created (default): exhibitions.created_at DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
    • oldest_created: exhibitions.created_at ASC, exhibitions.id ASC
    • name_a_z: exhibitions.name ASC, exhibitions.id ASC
    • name_z_a: exhibitions.name DESC, exhibitions.id DESC
  • Data Projection & Counts:
    • Excludes user_id and exhibition_id from the exhibition item.
    • Formats exhibition items with id, name (HTML unescaped), thumbnail, published, status, description, started, share_string, ended, unlimited_time, countdown_timer, cover_image, model_type, created_at, published_date, and creator user.
    • Replaced legacy total with camelCase tab count badges: totalPublished, totalDraft, and totalAll. Pagination page count is provided via totalPages.

2. Route Configuration (src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes.go)

exhibitions.Get("/published", controllers.GetPublishedExhibitions)
exhibitions.Get("/:sid", controllers.GetExhibitionDetail)

Only 1 endpoint is registered, placed before /:sid to ensure precedence.

3. API Collection Request

  • api-collection/Villume GO/Exhibitions/Get Published Exhibitions.yml

Verification & Tests

Automated Tests

  1. src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions_test.go:

    • TestResolveExhibitionOrder: Verifies SQL clauses for all 6 sort options.
    • TestIsAllowedPublishedExhibitionsEmail: Tests whitelist verification.
    • TestParseExhibitionPagination: Tests safe pagination defaults, bounds, and limits.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_UnauthorizedEmailForbidden: Validates 403 Forbidden.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_Unauthenticated: Validates 401 Unauthorized.
    • TestGetPublishedExhibitions_WithJWT: Validates JWT token flow.

  2. src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes_test.go:

    • TestPublishedExhibitionRoutesRequireAuth: Verifies GET /v1/exhibitions/published enforces authentication.
    • TestPublishedExhibitionRouteDoesNotCollideWithSid: Verifies /published routing precedence over /:sid.

Test Execution

go test -v ./src/action/v1/exhibition ./src/routes/v1
go test ./...

All test suites pass successfully.

Overview

Update and enhance the endpoint GET /v1/exhibitions/published to power the Virtual Galleries management area in the Support dropdown of the Villume Dashboard/Admin. Access is restricted exclusively to authorized operators with emails albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com.

The endpoint provides:

  1. Virtual gallery listing with pagination (page and limit).
  2. Key gallery information: thumbnail, name (gallery name), user.email (owner email), created_at (created date), published_date (published date), status (published or draft), and viewer/editor action helpers (share_string, user.username).
  3. Search by gallery name or owner email (?search=...).
  4. Filtering by published or draft status (?status=published|draft|all, defaults to published).
  5. Six sorting options: recently published, oldest published, recently created, oldest created, name A-Z, and name Z-A (?sort=...).
  6. Compatibility with existing admin flows: View Editor (via POST /v1/auth/impersonate using user.username) and View Gallery (via /viewers/:share_string).

Requirements

  1. Access Control:
    • Only authenticated users with verified emails albugsp@gmail.com and villumesupport@gmail.com are allowed.
    • Unauthenticated requests return 401 Unauthorized.
    • Authenticated users with other email addresses return 403 Forbidden.
  2. Search:
    • search query parameter searches case-insensitively across exhibitions.name and owner users.email (plus users.username).
  3. Status Filter:
    • status=published (default): Only published galleries (published = true).
    • status=draft: Only draft galleries (published = false).
    • status=all: Both published and draft galleries.
  4. Sorting Options (?sort=...):
    • recent_published: published_date DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC, id DESC
    • oldest_published: published_date ASC NULLS LAST, created_at ASC, id ASC
    • recent_created (default): created_at DESC, id DESC
    • oldest_created: created_at ASC, id ASC
    • name_a_z: name ASC, id ASC
    • name_z_a: name DESC, id DESC
  5. Pagination:
    • page (integer, default: 1).
    • limit (integer, default: 10, max: 100).
    • Overall count total and calculated totalPages.
  6. Data Contract:
    • Formatted like /v1/viewers/:username/exhibitions plus key management metadata:
      • id, name, thumbnail, published, status, description, started, share_string, ended, unlimited_time, countdown_timer, cover_image, model_type, created_at, published_date
    • Includes creator user (id, username, email, first_name, last_name, avatar).
    • Excludes user_id, exhibition_id, and heavy 3D scene data.

Scope

In scope:

  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions.go (handler with search, status filtering, 6-way sorting, pagination)
  • src/controllers/v1/exhibitionController.go (controller mapping)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes.go (GET /v1/exhibitions/published)
  • src/action/v1/exhibition/getPublishedExhibitions_test.go (unit tests)
  • src/routes/v1/exhibitionRoutes_test.go (route integration tests)
  • api-collection/Villume GO/Exhibitions/Get Published Exhibitions.yml (API collection request)

API Specification

  • Endpoint: GET /v1/exhibitions/published
  • Authentication: Bearer JWT Token
  • Query Parameters:
    • page (optional, default: 1): Current page number.
    • limit (optional, default: 10, max: 100): Items per page.
    • status (optional, default: published): published, draft, all.
    • search (optional): Search by gallery name or owner email.
    • sort (optional, default: recent_created): recent_published, oldest_published, recent_created, oldest_created, name_a_z, name_z_a.
  • Headers:
    • Authorization: Bearer <token>
    • X-Dev-Key: {{dev_key}} (optional, debug)
    • X-Disable-Encrypt: true (optional, debug)

Error Responses

  • 401 Unauthorized: Missing or invalid Bearer token.
  • 403 Forbidden: Authenticated user email is not in the allowed list (albugsp@gmail.com, villumesupport@gmail.com).

Acceptance Criteria

  1. GET /v1/exhibitions/published without token returns 401 Unauthorized.
  2. Valid token with email other than albugsp@gmail.com or villumesupport@gmail.com returns 403 Forbidden.
  3. Valid token with albugsp@gmail.com or villumesupport@gmail.com returns 200 OK.
  4. ?search=... filters by gallery name or owner email.
  5. ?status=published filters only published galleries; ?status=draft filters only draft galleries; ?status=all returns both.
  6. ?sort=... supports all 6 requested sorting options.
  7. Pagination and status counts output camelCase keys: totalPublished, totalDraft, totalAll, totalPages, page, limit.
  8. Exhibitions include status, created_at, published_date, share_string, and creator user (username, email).
  9. All unit and route integration tests pass (go test ./...).
